learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will revise the 26 English letters, remember vowels and consonants, and learn how to put words in ABC alphabetical order.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Welcome to Class 2! 🎉 Do you remember our 26 letter friends from the English alphabet family? Let's say a big 'Hello' to them and see how they stand in a neat and perfect line!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The English Alphabet has 26 letters. We can write them as Big Letters (Capital - A, B, C) and Small Letters (a, b, c). They always stay in a fixed order!
examples_or_templates: Capital: A B C D E
Small: a b c d e

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Out of 26 letters, 5 are special magic letters called Vowels (स्वर). The other 21 letters are called Consonants (व्यंजन). Vowels help make sound in almost every word!
examples_or_templates: Vowels: a, e, i, o, u
Consonants: b, c, d, f, g...

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we arrange words according to the alphabet (A first, then B, then C), it is called Alphabetical Order. It is like making words stand in a queue for morning assembly!

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of these is the correct Alphabetical Order?
❓ How many vowels are there in the English Alphabet?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Arrange these words in ABC order: Dog, Ant, Boy.
subjective_practice.hint: Look at the first letter of each word. A comes first, then B, then D.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write the missing vowels in this word: B __ K __ R
subjective_practice.hint: Think of someone who bakes cakes! (a, e)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Circle the consonant in the word 'EGG'.
subjective_practice.hint: E is a vowel, what are the other letters?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 My Family ABCs
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write down the names of 3 people in your family. Now, try to arrange their names in alphabetical (ABC) order!

chapter_summary: ⭐ There are 26 letters in the English Alphabet.
⭐ a, e, i, o, u are the 5 Vowels.
⭐ Arranging words from A to Z is called Alphabetical Order.
